categories: MA 材料分析 (Materials Analysis - TEM/SEM/FIB sub-nm Crystal & GAA/Backside Power)
FA 故障分析 (Failure Analysis - EMMI/OBIRCH/Delayering & Defect Localization)
RA 可靠度分析 (Reliability Analysis - Automotive AEC-Q100/HAST/Thermal Shock/Burn-in)

the_pivot.en: MA-tek (閎康科技) stands as Asia’s foremost independent semiconductor laboratory and analytical testing powerhouse. Driven by TSMC, Intel, and Samsung sub-2nm GAA nanosheet transitions and 3D advanced packaging (CoWoS/SoIC), demand for ultra-high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and atomic-scale Material Analysis (MA) has anchored gross margins above 32%-37%. Global footprint expansion across Taiwan (Hsinchu/Tainan), Japan (Kumamoto/Nagoya), and China provides strong geographic operating leverage.
the_pivot.zh: 閎康科技（MA-tek）為亞洲獨立半導體檢測分析實驗室龍頭。受惠於台積電、Intel 與三星次 2 奈米 GAA 環繞閘極奈米片製程演進及 3D 先進封裝（CoWoS/SoIC）研發潮，超高解析度穿透式電子顯微鏡（TEM）與原子級材料分析（MA）需求強勁，帶動毛利率長年穩居 32%～37% 之高附加價值區間。佈局台灣（竹科/南科）、日本（熊本/名古屋）與中國實驗室網絡，構築強大地域運營槓桿。

productivity.en: Revenue per employee reached $96.8k-$100k+ with Gross Profit per FTE exceeding $32k, supported by a dense workforce of elite PhD/Master material scientists and high-precision analytical equipment (TEM, Dual-beam FIB, SIMS, XPS).
productivity.zh: 每位員工平均營收約 9.7 萬至 10 萬美元以上，人均毛利達 3.2 萬美元，由高階碩博士材料科學家與昂貴尖端檢測儀器（TEM、雙束 FIB、二次離子質譜 SIMS、XPS）共同創造高知識密集型產值。

value_vs_volume.en: Despite heavy depreciation from new overseas laboratories in Japan (Kumamoto 1 & 2, Nagoya) in 2024-2025, surging global automotive chip verification (AEC-Q100) and AI accelerator high-power reliability testing (RA) provide an enduring structural growth runway.
value_vs_volume.zh: 儘管 2024～2025 年受日本熊本一二廠及名古屋新實驗室折舊初期費用影響，車用晶片驗證（AEC-Q100）與 AI 加速晶片高瓦數可靠度測試（RA）的爆發性成長，為長期營運提供結構性推進動能。
